execution_scope: Read-only exact-head source, PR/issue and retained log inspection; no builds, tests, checker, CI polls, source edits or GitHub messages

findings.title: Permanently undersized canonical Quantity Cord can remain admitted and Await forever
findings.requirement: #6387: Do not hide an undersized permanent Cord behind an infinite Await
findings.trigger: Use actual four-Gear canonical Quantity Source, but explicitly request map.out→wrap.in or wrap.out→show.input byte_capacity one below complete canonical value. Alternatively reduce a selected offer max_queue_bytes below complete value while retaining exact Fore identity.
source_chain: catalog contract.rs attaches canonical raw and wrapped bounds to reviewed Fores; default_queues.rs required_value_bytes derives them.
default_queues.rs:94-101 clamps required bytes down to source/sink max_queue_bytes; no refusal for clamp below required bound.

validated_planning.rs:239-247 accepts explicit connection limits and calls quantity_wire::validate_capacity. That final fence at quantity_wire.rs:75-93 only requires storage for Exact Quantity profile; canonical Decimal and wrapped structured leaf remain unchecked. Remaining validated_planning.rs:301-321 queue tests reject above-offer capacities, not below-value capacities.

plan-lowering/src/lowering.rs:1005-1020 calls admitted_maximum_value_bytes with original bound and Cord capacity; helper min-clamps rather than refusing. Existing helper regression at1502-1505 expects Some(256),64→64.

scheduler.rs:3696-3697 then accepts clipped maximum_value_bytes <= byte_capacity. payload_admission.rs:69-85 computes available bytes from immutable total Cord capacity; draining cannot increase it above that total.

MathScalarBack verifies complete output fixed size, then output_ready_for false returns Await without consuming completion. For permanently too-small total capacity it will never become true. Existing factory identity/port/config checks do not compare output bytes with Cord capacity.
findings.proof_strength: Concrete source chain; no runtime reproduction executed by this reviewer. Request focused actual-path regression to authenticate observed refusal/deadlock result.
minimal_regression: Extend installed_std_tests/math_conformance.rs existing run_presented_quantity/source test so planner mode can use plan_expanded_canonical_with_connection_limits and exact per-endpoint override. Keep all other hosts, checked Source, placements and semantic contracts unchanged.

Case A: map.out→wrap.in raw canonical byte_capacity QUANTITY_ENCODED_LEN-1. Case B: wrap.out→show.input capacity quantity_info_prefix().len()+QUANTITY_ENCODED_LEN-1. Require ordinary planning/pre-Play admission refusal; do not execute an unbounded scheduler loop.

Case C: use ordinary default planner, lower relevant selected offer max_queue_bytes to one short while preserving matching Fore/semantic contract; require finite pre-Play refusal rather than clamping to an impossible Cord. If host preparation independently rejects that offer earlier, retain that exact refusal as positive acceptance evidence.

Keep current default complete-queue installed success exact presented bytes/Sign/Plan/Play and existing temporary StepIo pressure test where capacity later increases; that latter case should still retain result and deliver once.
findings.repair_direction: Add final generic checked Fore/value-bound vs admitted per-connection capacity fence shared by default and explicit paths; preserve unrelated representation profiles, existing finite offer limits, and temporary runtime backpressure. Do not globally widen queues or merely add a timeout.

source_positive_findings: Complete canonical Quantity/raw wrapper/display Front bounds are narrowly attached to known reviewed Fores; unrelated Quantity realization profiles are not globally assigned this representation.
into_semantic_contract retains reviewed configuration/startup/terminal semantics and adds checked value law; palette test checks canonical wrapper Fore identity.
Full byte capacity is observed before consuming a completion; no output/fault/result consumption occurs under temporary partial capacity.

Retained five completion, seven installed and ten catalog logs are positive historical source-specific proof; old OutputBlocked and subsequent TextTooLong failures remain beside combined local success.
readiness_gates: Resolve/authenticate permanent-capacity issue with actual canonical planner regression.
Run affected final-source validation and repository Candidate/normal integration after owner handoff; retained historical/combined logs do not certify exact isolated PR head.
intentionally_separate: #6351/#6349 GUI Sign/transcript projection repair and original complex GUI lifecycle belong to combined dependent proof; PR body explicitly marks combined ref and does not falsely claim isolated-head GUI success.
No fresh WASM, native, physical, merge or publication proof claimed; do not require unrelated numeric/profile issues #5392/#6016 for this scoped runtime repair.
Issue6387 stays open; this review does not certify full issue closure or mark the draft ready.

proposed_repair_scope_review.assessment: Do not enforce all CheckedValueContract maxima as required minimum Cord storage. Maximum is permitted upper bound; generic variable-width values can fit smaller admitted Cords. Existing lowerer clamp regression establishes that intended behavior.
smallest_generic_correct_direction: Attach explicit existing ValueConstraint::ByteLength{minimum:exact_len,maximum:exact_len} only to these reviewed fixed canonical raw/wrapped Quantity contracts; preserve unrelated profile and Face upper-bound semantics.

Keep default max-based queue sizing preference. At shared final planning admission require capacity >= explicit guaranteed minimum byte length, rather than capacity >= arbitrary allowed maximum. This catches explicit and default-host-clamped impossible fixed-value Cords.
Add a contrasting variable-length upper-bound-only contract test proving an intentionally smaller Cord still admits fitting values. Preserve temporary Math pressure retry/exact-once behavior.
Exempt both NormalClose and Quiescence token tracks consistently with existing lowering; retain track-specific abnormal contract selection.
proposed_repair_scope_review.limitations: Source reasoning only, no new law code, tests, checks, builds or source edits. Root must verify constraint propagation through palette/offer identity and actual planner/kernel regressions.
